intervention: Optional bounded argv for catalogued project tasks; no automatic script rewriting or proof promotion

hypotheses.mechanism: Separating task identity from argv allows filtered project checks without invented task IDs or fallback shell retries.
hypotheses.measure: Task-selection refusals, actual argv usage, independently scored success; then input/output/cache, reported SDK cost and elapsed time at comparable audited quality.
hypotheses.comparison: Frozen baseline Blame, modified Blame, integrated native Cline SDK 0.0.82
hypotheses.regressionRisk: Incorrect npm separator, changed argument order or filtered checks incorrectly treated as full-scope proof. Preserve legacy invocations and conservative test admission.

hypotheses.mechanism: Invocation-attributed reports plus explicit source/environment/scope admission could improve honest delivery and remove uncertainty without equating passing counts to acceptance.
hypotheses.measure: False verified completions and false unknown observations in isolated replays, then audited success.
hypotheses.comparison: Existing conservative policy versus a future single proof-admission change
hypotheses.regressionRisk: Unsound evidence from external writers, installed dependencies, inherited output or incomplete selection. Not implemented in this campaign.

transport: Configured BLAME API and openai-codex credential; secret never archived
environment: Shared Linux x64 worker; fresh identical fixture and source baseline per trial; pinned lockfile/toolchain; no memory; no solution retrieval allowed for any arm

budget.policy: Use task iteration/time budgets unchanged; no replacement trials; no cost claim if accounting is incomplete

ordering: Cyclic task/arm ordering in repetition one; reverse each order in repetition two. Sequential trials; provider cache cannot be reset.
quality: Keep original corpus qualityScore and runtime status. Audited success requires all functional checks, typecheck, no unexpected product changes, required task-specific obligations and no solution retrieval; runtime success and verified flags remain separate.
accounting: Retain all failures and timeouts. Input includes cached input; output includes reasoning; do not add cache or reasoning twice. Reconcile per-request usage against SDK aggregate and started model iterations. Missing remains null. Cost is SDK-reported/estimated, not invoice. Runner time, preparation, verification and outer wall time separate; parallel tool spans are not summed as elapsed time.
interpretation: Small pilot; no statistical superiority, no pooled historical results. Keep only a mechanically verified compatible change; deepen H1 if models actually exercise it without quality regression. Do not claim token savings when audited quality differs or usage is incomplete.
